title: Implement immutable versioned deployment directories
description: Make production deployment use a unique versioned release directory and keep mutable data/config outside the release payload.
acceptanceCriteria: Each release has a unique version/digest-derived directory and is not overwritten after activation
Mutable SQLite data, keys, logs, env file, and tunnel binaries are stored outside the immutable app release where the runtime contract requires
A manifest identifies the active release and previous release
Interrupted extraction leaves the current active release untouched and produces a clear cleanup/error state

steps.details: Create a fixture that deploys a release twice and expects two distinct directories with identical manifest content for the same immutable artifact.
Update installer/deploy script to create a sanitized versioned directory, extract there, and never mutate a published directory.
Keep data/config paths under their existing external directories and ensure the artifact excludes databases, keys, logs, and local env values.
On extraction failure, remove only the incomplete candidate and retain the previous active release; report the path and reason.
Run the deployment-layout and existing installer syntax checks.

technicalNotes: Do not use `rm -rf` against a computed path without validating it is under the controlled install root.
